title: PAN Card Apply Online 2026: Form 93 (Old 49A), Fees, e-PAN
meta_description: PAN card apply online 2026: Form 93 replaced 49A from April 1. Free instant e-PAN via Aadhaar, Rs 107 physical card, minor age rules, photo size, lost PAN fix.

hero.one_liner: Get a free instant e-PAN in 10 minutes or a physical card in 7-15 days. Form 93 replaced Form 49A from April 1, 2026, and most guides have not caught up.

sections.heading: Why You Need a PAN Card
content: A PAN (Permanent Account Number) is a 10-character code issued by the Income Tax Department, like ABCDE1234F. It is your permanent tax identity and it never expires.

Income tax: you need a PAN to file ITR, and filing becomes mandatory once your income crosses the basic exemption limit. Even below that limit, filing with a PAN lets you claim TDS refunds and build a financial record.
Banking and investment: banks ask for PAN during KYC, and mutual funds, stocks, and FDs all require it. Without a PAN, banks deduct TDS at 20% on FD interest instead of 10%.
Credit: every credit card and loan application is checked against the CIBIL history linked to your PAN. No PAN means no formal credit trail.
Property and salary: property registration, inheritance claims, and salary TDS all quote your PAN. Employers cannot process salary tax without it.
One hard rule before you apply: holding two PANs is illegal under Section 272B and carries a ₹10,000 penalty. If you ever had a PAN, use reprint or correction, never a fresh application.

sections.heading: Form 49A Is Now Form 93: What Changed in April 2026
content: If you searched for PAN card Form 49A, stop here first. Form 49A and Form 49AA were discontinued on March 31, 2026, and applications on old forms are rejected.
From April 1, 2026, four new forms apply under the Income Tax Act, 2025 and Income Tax Rules, 2026. Indian citizens, including minors and NRIs, now use Form 93.
Your existing PAN is not affected. Cards and numbers issued under Form 49A remain fully valid for tax, banking, and KYC, and you do not need to reapply.
Applications that were already pending on March 31, 2026 are also processed normally. The new forms apply only to applications filed on or after April 1.

Two new rules trip people up. Aadhaar now counts only as identity and address proof, so you must attach a separate date-of-birth document, and a mobile number plus email ID are mandatory on every application.

sections.heading: Aadhaar is no longer date-of-birth proof
sections.content:
Under the 2026 rules, Aadhaar works as identity and address proof only. Attach a separate DOB document such as a birth certificate, passport, or 10th marksheet.

Children born on or after October 1, 2023 must submit a birth certificate as DOB proof. Keep it ready before you start the form.

sections.heading: 3 Ways to Get a PAN Card in 2026
content: Method 1, instant e-PAN: free at incometax.gov.in if you have Aadhaar with a linked mobile number and have never held a PAN. You get a legally valid e-PAN PDF in about 10 minutes, with no physical card mailed.
The catch: this route is for adults only, and it fails if your Aadhaar mobile link is broken. Minors and anyone without Aadhaar must use Form 93 instead.

Method 2, Protean (formerly NSDL): apply at onlineservices.nsdl.com with Form 93. Paperless e-KYC costs ₹101, physical document submission costs ₹107, and you get both an e-PAN and a physical card in 7-15 working days.
Method 3, UTIITSL: the same Form 93 process at pan.utiitsl.com, at the same fee. Both portals are authorised by the Income Tax Department, so pick whichever loads better for you.
Offline still works too. Fill Form 93 at a PAN centre with photocopies and two photographs, and the card arrives in 15-20 days.
For a foreign delivery address the fee is ₹1,017 because of international postage. NRIs use Form 93 with a passport, and foreign citizens use Form 95.

sections.heading: How to Get Instant e-PAN (FREE, 10 Minutes)

steps.title: Go to incometax.gov.in → Instant e-PAN
steps.description: Visit the Income Tax e-Filing portal at https://incometax.gov.in. Look for 'Instant e-PAN' under Quick Links. No registration or login required. The portal is available 24/7.

steps.title: Enter Aadhaar number
steps.description: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number. Confirm that you don't have an existing PAN. Accept the terms and conditions. The system checks whether you're already registered in the PAN system - if you have a PAN, you cannot get instant e-PAN again (apply for reprint instead).

steps.title: Verify with Aadhaar OTP
steps.description: OTP is automatically sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile number (last 4 digits shown on screen). Enter the OTP within 3 minutes. Your identity is verified through Aadhaar e-KYC - this is a live government authentication, so no document upload needed. The system confirms 'OTP verified'.

steps.title: PAN is generated instantly
steps.description: Your PAN number is allotted immediately. The screen displays your 10-digit PAN. Download the e-PAN (PDF) from the same page - save this file and take a printout. The e-PAN also goes to your email registered with Aadhaar within 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Start using your PAN
steps.description: Your e-PAN is legally valid for all purposes - tax filing, bank KYC, investments, credit cards, property registration. No physical card is sent. The PDF e-PAN is self-authenticated and accepted by all government agencies and banks. You can use this for immediate needs while a physical card (if ordered separately) arrives.

sections.heading: How to Apply for Physical PAN Card (Protean/NSDL Online)

steps.title: Visit onlineservices.nsdl.com
steps.description: Go to https://onlineservices.nsdl.com, the Protean portal. Click 'PAN - New/Change Request'. Select 'New PAN - Indian Citizen (Form 93)' for a fresh PAN, or the change/correction request if you already hold one.

steps.title: Fill Form 93 online
steps.description: Enter personal details: full name (must match Aadhaar exactly - check spelling), date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY), father's name, mother's name, gender, residential address, email, mobile number. Choose source of income: salaried, self-employed, business, investment, or others. The form auto-suggests AO code (Assessing Officer code) based on your address - verify this is correct as it determines your tax jurisdiction. You can change the AO code if required.

steps.title: Upload documents, photo and signature
steps.description: Upload identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving licence), address proof, and a separate DOB proof (birth certificate, passport, or 10th marksheet; Aadhaar is not accepted for DOB). Documents go as PDF up to 300KB per page, photo as JPEG 3.5 x 2.5 cm under 50KB, signature as JPEG 2 x 4.5 cm under 50KB.

steps.title: Pay ₹101-107 and submit
steps.description: Pay by debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI. Paperless mode costs ₹101 and physical document submission costs ₹107. After payment you get a 15-digit acknowledgment number. Save it, every status check needs it.

steps.title: Track your application status
steps.description: Visit https://tin.tin.nsdl.com/pantan/StatusTrack.html or https://www.utiitsl.com/pan/panstatus. Enter your acknowledgment number and DOB. The status shows: 'Pending', 'Approved', 'Dispatched', or 'Delivered'. You can also check the status at incometax.gov.in if you have an e-filing login.

steps.title: Receive e-PAN and physical card
steps.description: The e-PAN PDF is emailed within 2-3 working days of approval. The physical card is printed and dispatched within 7-15 working days to your form address. If it does not arrive in 3 weeks, raise a query on the portal with your acknowledgment number.

sections.heading: Instant e-PAN: the fastest route
sections.content:
incometax.gov.in, then Instant e-PAN, then Aadhaar number, then OTP. The PAN generates in about 10 minutes and the PDF lands on your email, free.

It works only for first-time adult applicants whose Aadhaar has a live mobile link. Everyone else goes through Form 93 on Protean or UTIITSL.

sections.heading: PAN Card Fees (2026)
rows: About ₹50, exact fee shown at payment

sections.heading: PAN Card Photo and Signature Size
content: Wrong image sizes are the most common reason an online PAN application stalls at the upload step. The portal validates dimensions, format, and file size, and silently rejects files that miss any of them.
On the Protean portal the photo must be 3.5 cm high by 2.5 cm wide at 200 DPI, in JPEG, under 50KB. The signature must be 2 cm high by 4.5 cm wide, also JPEG under 50KB.
UTIITSL runs slightly different limits, commonly a 213 x 213 pixel photo under 30KB. Check the upload hints on whichever portal you use before resizing.
Sign in black or dark blue ink on plain white paper and photograph it in good light. A cluttered background or a shadow across the face is the usual cause of photo rejection.
Supporting documents upload as PDF, up to 300KB per page on Protean. Free browser tools resize all of these in a minute, so do it before starting the form, not during.

sections.heading: PAN Card for Minors: Age Rules That Confuse Everyone
content: There is no minimum age for a PAN card. A newborn can have one, so the questions about applying at 16 or 17 have a simple answer: yes, at any age below 18, through a parent or guardian.

The child cannot apply alone. The parent or legal guardian fills Form 93 and signs as the Representative Assessee under Part E, attaching their own identity and address proof alongside the child's DOB proof.
The instant Aadhaar e-PAN route is not available for minors. Applications go through Protean or UTIITSL only, at the normal ₹101-107 fee.
A minor's card looks different: it carries no photograph and no signature of the child. Banks accept it for accounts, SSY, FDs, and mutual fund folios opened in the child's name.
At 18, the card must be updated with the holder's own photo and signature through a correction request. The 10-character PAN number itself never changes.
Once the person is 18 or older, they apply directly in their own name on Form 93, or use the free instant e-PAN if they hold Aadhaar.

sections.heading: Lost PAN Card: Reprint It, Never Reapply
content: Losing the card changes nothing about your PAN. The number stays alive, so the fix is a reprint, and a fresh application would create an illegal second PAN.
If your PAN is linked with Aadhaar, download the e-PAN free at incometax.gov.in first. That PDF is valid everywhere, and many people never replace the plastic at all.
For a physical copy, use Reprint of PAN Card on the Protean or UTIITSL portal. The fee is ₹50 for an Indian address and the card arrives in about two weeks with the same number.
Forgot the number itself? Use Know Your PAN on incometax.gov.in with your name, DOB, and registered mobile, and it retrieves the PAN in minutes.

sections.heading: One person = one PAN only
sections.content:
Holding more than one PAN is illegal under Section 272B, with a ₹10,000 penalty. It usually happens by accident, a forgotten old card followed by a fresh application.

If you have two, surrender the extra one through a correction request on the Protean portal or at your local income tax office. Keep the PAN that is linked to your bank and Aadhaar.

sections.heading: Corrections and Updates
content: Name, DOB, father's name, and address are all fixed through the change/correction request on Protean or UTIITSL under the new 2026 forms. Upload proof of the correct detail, such as a marriage certificate for a name change or a birth certificate for DOB.
The corrected card arrives in 7-15 days and your PAN number stays the same. For an Indian address the fee is about ₹50, and the portal shows the exact amount before payment.
The correction that matters most: your PAN name must match your Aadhaar name exactly. A mismatch blocks PAN-Aadhaar linking, delays ITR processing, and freezes refunds.
After marriage or any legal name change, update PAN immediately. Old-name PAN with new-name bank KYC is a mismatch banks will eventually flag.

sections.heading: PAN-Aadhaar Linking: Still Mandatory
content: An unlinked PAN turns inoperative. That blocks ITR filing, refund credit, new bank accounts, and most transactions above ₹50,000.
Link at incometax.gov.in under Link Aadhaar. If your deadline has passed, pay the ₹1,000 late fee through e-Pay Tax first, then link, and the PAN reactivates in up to 30 days.
A name mismatch between the two documents makes linking fail silently. Fix the name on either PAN or follow the linking guide step by step if you are stuck.
Check where you stand anytime at incometax.gov.in under Link Aadhaar Status. It shows linked, or inoperative with the reason.

sections.heading: Check linking before you need it
sections.content:
Most people discover an inoperative PAN at the worst moment, mid loan application or during ITR season. The status check takes 30 seconds at incometax.gov.in.

If it shows inoperative, budget the ₹1,000 fee and up to 30 days for reactivation. Plan around that before any deadline.

sections.heading: Where PAN Is Required
content: Quoting PAN is mandatory for ITR filing, opening bank accounts and FDs, all mutual fund and share investments, property deals above ₹10 lakh, and vehicle purchases above ₹5 lakh. Cash deposits above ₹50,000 in a day also require it.
Hotel bills above ₹50,000 and foreign travel spends above ₹50,000 in cash quote PAN too. The department uses these trails to match spending against declared income.
Without PAN, TDS on your income runs at 20% instead of the normal rate. On ₹1 lakh of FD interest that is ₹20,000 withheld instead of ₹10,000, recoverable only by filing ITR with a PAN.
Every TDS entry against your PAN shows in Form 26AS at incometax.gov.in. Check it once a year, because mismatches there are how refunds get stuck.

sections.text: Instant e-PAN through the income tax portal is free for first-time adult applicants with Aadhaar. No fees, no document uploads, PAN in about 10 minutes.

sections.heading: PAN for Specific Situations
content: Students turning 18: apply even without income. A PAN prevents 20% TDS on FD interest and is required the day you start a demat account or first job.
NRIs: needed for property, NRO/NRE accounts, mutual funds, and ITR in India. Apply on Form 93 with a passport, and expect the ₹1,017 fee for foreign delivery.
Companies, LLPs, firms, and trusts registered in India now use Form 94. A business PAN is required for GST registration, the current account, and every business ITR.
Senior citizens: if a parent has no PAN and their FD interest crosses the senior threshold, the bank deducts 20% TDS. A one-time free instant e-PAN fixes years of excess deduction.

sections.heading: PAN and Income Tax: The Connection
content: PAN is the thread that ties your income, investments, large spends, and taxes into one ledger the department can read. High-value transactions without matching declared income invite notices on that PAN.
Filing ITR even below the taxable limit has real upside: TDS refunds, loss carry-forward, and an income record that lenders and visa officers treat as proof of financial life.
The PAN is issued for life and never needs renewal. Correct it when details change, link it to Aadhaar, and it quietly does its job for decades.
All official routes in one line: instant e-PAN at incometax.gov.in, new applications and corrections at onlineservices.nsdl.com (Protean) or pan.utiitsl.com, linking and status at incometax.gov.in.

faqs.question: Is Form 49A still valid for PAN application in 2026?
faqs.answer:
No. Form 49A and Form 49AA were discontinued on March 31, 2026 and new applications on them are rejected.

Indian citizens, including minors and NRIs, now use Form 93. Entities registered in India use Form 94, foreign applicants use Form 95 or 96.

PANs already issued under Form 49A remain fully valid. You do not need to reapply.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for a PAN card? Can a 16 or 17-year-old apply?
faqs.answer:
There is no minimum age, so a 16 or 17-year-old can get a PAN. Until 18, the application is filed by a parent or legal guardian on Form 93, signed under Part E as Representative Assessee.

The instant Aadhaar e-PAN is not available below 18. From 18 onwards you apply in your own name, and the free instant e-PAN route opens up.

faqs.question: What is the PAN card photo size in KB?
faqs.answer:
On the Protean portal: photo 3.5 x 2.5 cm at 200 DPI, JPEG, maximum 50KB. Signature 2 x 4.5 cm, JPEG, maximum 50KB.

UTIITSL commonly asks for a 213 x 213 pixel photo under 30KB. Check the upload hint on your portal and resize before starting the form.

faqs.question: I already have e-PAN. How do I get a physical PAN card?
faqs.answer:
Use Reprint of PAN Card at onlineservices.nsdl.com or pan.utiitsl.com. The fee is ₹50 for an Indian address and the card arrives in 7-15 days.

Your PAN number stays the same. This is a reprint on plastic, not a new application.

faqs.question: Can I apply for PAN without Aadhaar?
faqs.answer:
Indian residents eligible for Aadhaar must quote it under Section 139AA, so get Aadhaar first at uidai.gov.in if you do not have it. Note that from April 2026 Aadhaar no longer works as date-of-birth proof, so a separate DOB document is needed anyway.

NRIs, OCI holders, and foreign nationals can apply without Aadhaar using a passport, on Form 93 or Form 95 as applicable.

faqs.question: I made a mistake while applying. Can I cancel and reapply?
faqs.answer:
Once the application is accepted you cannot cancel it. Wait for the PAN, then fix errors through a change/correction request.

Never file a second fresh application, because two PANs against one person is a ₹10,000 penalty under Section 272B.

faqs.question: How do I correct a wrong name or DOB on PAN?
faqs.answer:
Use the change/correction request at onlineservices.nsdl.com or pan.utiitsl.com and upload proof of the correct detail, such as Aadhaar for name or a birth certificate for DOB. The updated card arrives in 7-15 days with the same PAN number.

Fix name mismatches quickly. PAN and Aadhaar names must match exactly or linking and ITR processing break.

faqs.question: I lost my PAN card. How do I get a duplicate?
faqs.answer:
Your PAN number survives the lost card. If it is linked to Aadhaar, download the e-PAN free at incometax.gov.in, which is valid everywhere.

For a physical copy, order Reprint of PAN Card at Protean or UTIITSL for ₹50 (Indian address). It arrives in about two weeks.

faqs.question: Is e-PAN legally valid everywhere?
faqs.answer:
Yes. The e-PAN PDF is government-authenticated and fully valid for ITR filing, bank KYC, investments, loans, and property registration.

Many people never order the physical card at all. Banks and government offices accept the e-PAN as complete proof of PAN.

faqs.question: How do I check my PAN application status online?
faqs.answer:
Track it with your acknowledgment number at tin.tin.nsdl.com/pantan/StatusTrack.html or utiitsl.com/pan/panstatus. Status moves through pending, approved, dispatched, and delivered.

If you have an e-filing login at incometax.gov.in, the dashboard shows PAN status too.

faqs.question: What happens if I have multiple PANs?
faqs.answer:
It is illegal under Section 272B with a ₹10,000 penalty, and it causes TDS mismatches and ITR rejection. Surrender the extra PAN through a correction request or at your local income tax office.

Keep the PAN that is linked to Aadhaar and your bank accounts, and surrender the other.

faqs.question: Can a minor get a PAN card?
faqs.answer:
Yes, at any age. A parent or guardian applies on Form 93 and signs as Representative Assessee under Part E, attaching the child's DOB proof and their own ID and address proof.

The minor's card carries no photo or signature. At 18 it must be updated with both, and the PAN number stays the same.

faqs.question: How do I update my name or address on the PAN card?
faqs.answer:
File a change/correction request on Protean or UTIITSL with supporting proof, Aadhaar for name or a utility bill for address. For an Indian address the fee is about ₹50, shown exactly at the payment step.

Processing takes 7-15 days and the PAN number does not change.

faqs.question: What is the difference between PAN and TAN?
faqs.answer:
PAN tracks a person's or entity's own income tax. TAN is held by deductors, employers and banks that cut TDS from payments they make.

Individuals never need a TAN. Both are 10-character codes with different jobs.

disclaimer: This guide is based on current NSDL and UTIITSL processes and Income Tax Department rules as of March 2026. Fees, procedures, and eligibility criteria may change. Always verify at https://incometax.gov.in or https://onlineservices.nsdl.com for the latest updates. Consult a tax professional for complex situations like multiple PAN consolidation or NRI PAN applications.
